option.value:
this project is about a Job and Invoicing assist system, keep this in mind. I'm developing a simple job and invoicing system for a tablet that is built in a wheel loader machine, it’s really simple app. - enables machine owners (operators) to manage their work planning and invoicing directly from the machine. - The app should allow operators to create, edit and saving work plans - register worked hours, materials and services - view existing work plans - through Fortnox API generate invoices and send it via mail.
Job Invoicing Assistant project: •Target Device: A tablet mounted in a wheel loader. This implies the UI should be simple, with large, easy-to-press buttons and clear text, usable in potentially bright or shaky conditions. •Core User: The machine operator. The workflow must be straightforward and intuitive for someone whose primary job is operating heavy machinery, not data entry. •Main Features: i. Work Plan Management: Create, view, and modify job plans directly on the device. ii. Data Logging: Easily log work hours, materials used (like gravel, sand, etc.), and services performed. iii. Invoice Generation: through Fortnox API generate invoices. •Technology Stack: The app is a native Android application using Java and the Room persistence library for offline data storage, which is crucial for a vehicle that might have intermittent connectivity.
